svg.title: Two orders of orthogonal rotations on one vector
svg.desc: Left: (1,2,3) maps under Q1 to (1,-3,2), then under Q3 to (3,1,2). Right: (1,2,3) maps under Q3 to (-2,1,3), then under Q1 to (-2,-3,1). Arrows run from the origin to these exact vectors. Both projections use equal coordinate scales and the same view. The sphere radius is square root of 14.
